note: City of Trenton with expanded service to surrounding areas; exact coverage of surrounding areas not specified

name: MicroLink (NJ Transit)
note: Pilot covers small zones WITHIN named towns, not the full counties: Bergen zone is centered on the Knickerbocker Rd corridor (sections of Bergenfield, Tenafly, Englewood, Teaneck); Monmouth service area 1 covers sections of Manalapan/Marlboro (to Union Hill Park & Ride, Marlboro); service area 2 covers sections of Freehold Township/Freehold Borough (to Freehold Mall Park & Ride) -- Freehold Township is not separately resolvable from TIGER/Line place data (collides with Freehold Borough under this tool's name matching), so only the Freehold Borough polygon is included and the mapped area understates that zone's true footprint. No zone size or exact boundary published as of launch (April 2026). Source: https://www.njtransit.com/press-releases/nj-transit-pilot-microtransit-shuttle-service-monmouth-and-bergen-counties
